summary_en: 2,800,000 shares (2.96% of shares outstanding), ¥10.0B upper limit, open-market acquisition on TSE, Aug 12–Dec 30, 2026. Execution supports ≥40% total payout ratio target announced Feb 16, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters concerning Acquisition of Own Shares (Acquisition of Own Shares pursuant to Articles of Incorporation under Article 165(2) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
DIC Corporation announced on August 10, 2026, that its board of directors has authorized an acquisition of up to 2,800,000 of its own shares (2.96% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥10.0 billion. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 12 and December 30, 2026.

The buyback is undertaken to support the company's shareholder return policy announced February 16, 2026, which commits to a minimum dividend of ¥120 per share and a total payout ratio of 40% or higher. The company intends to use buybacks as a supplementary tool alongside dividends to enhance shareholder value, with execution timing and scale calibrated to full-year FY2026 earnings guidance and financial position. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 443,861 treasury shares (including 243,500 shares held in a share-based compensation trust) against 94,713,043 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
